# AI Chat

## GET `/api/v1/chat/sessions`
List private chat sessions của authenticated user
- operationId: `listChatSessions`
- Params: `query:page (integer)`, `query:limit (integer)`
- Request: —
- Responses: `200` → ChatSessionListResponse, `400` → ErrorResponse, `401` → ErrorResponse, `403` → ErrorResponse

## POST `/api/v1/chat/sessions`
Tạo private chat session cho authenticated user hoặc guest
- operationId: `createChatSession`
- Params: —
- Request: `CreateChatSessionRequest` (required)
- Responses: `201` → ChatSessionResponse, `400` → ErrorResponse, `401` → ErrorResponse, `403` → ErrorResponse, `423` → ErrorResponse

## GET `/api/v1/chat/sessions/{id}/messages`
Đọc message history theo ownership
- operationId: `listChatMessages`
- Params: `path:id* (string)`, `query:page (integer)`, `query:limit (integer)`
- Request: —
- Responses: `200` → ChatMessageListResponse, `400` → ErrorResponse, `401` → ErrorResponse, `403` → ErrorResponse, `404` → ErrorResponse

## POST `/api/v1/chat/sessions/{id}/messages`
Stream nutrition answer qua SSE
- operationId: `streamChatMessage`
- Params: `path:id* (string)`
- Request: `SendChatMessageRequest` (required)
- Responses: `200` → ChatSseStream, `400` → ErrorResponse, `401` → ErrorResponse, `403` → ErrorResponse, `404` → ErrorResponse, `409` → ErrorResponse, `423` → ErrorResponse, `429` → ErrorResponse, `503` → ErrorResponse

## POST `/api/v1/chat/messages/{id}/feedback`
Upsert feedback cho owned assistant message
- operationId: `upsertChatFeedback`
- Params: `path:id* (string)`
- Request: `ChatFeedbackRequest` (required)
- Responses: `200` → ChatFeedbackResponse, `400` → ErrorResponse, `401` → ErrorResponse, `403` → ErrorResponse, `404` → ErrorResponse, `423` → ErrorResponse
